messages:
marco: FYI deploybot attempted to unpin SDK 3.9 -> 4.0 in us-central during the nightly window and the runtime telemetry detected extra trailing nulls in embeddings. I re-pinned to 3.9 to stop the spill. tagging @sdk-anna @tess

deploybot: Automatic action: pinned sdk 3.9 in region us-central. reason=embedding-trailing-nulls. cmd=/deploybot pin sdk us-central 3.9 --reason embedding-trailing-nulls

tess: What do the client errors look like? Any 5xxs or just malformed responses?

sre-lee: No server 5xxs. We see client-side rejects and a spike in SDK deserializer warnings:  
```
WARN embed_deserialize: trailing_nulls_detected=true trimmed_bytes=64 client=sdk-3.9->4.0 request_id=qwe456
```
Some downstream pipelines that assert exact-length embeddings are failing (ETL jobs).

sdk-anna: SDK 4.0 intentionally started padding to 2048 for alignment on some AVX kernels; we thought consumers would ignore trailing zeros. Looks like some partners rely on strict length checks.

marco: Quick options: (1) keep pin and ship 4.0.1 removing the padding, (2) keep 4.0 but introduce an opt-in compatibility header so older consumers get trimmed vectors, (3) runtime-side adapter to auto-trim zeros for requests flagged compat=legacy. Which is least risky?

ops-bot: Action: hold auto-unpin for 12h placed. Notified release-ops and api-oncall.

qa-bot: Preflight check: run matrix of 1000 embedding calls across sdk versions and runtimes. Currently failing cases: consumers with strict-length assertions. Estimated time to run: 45m after hotfix build.

tess: I'm leaning toward option (2) then (1): do an opt-in header for the immediate fix so we can unpin safely, and prepare a 4.0.1 patch to avoid unexpected padding. We should avoid touching runtime kernels.

sre-lee: Agree. Runtime adapter adds stateful routing complexity; prefer client-side change or opt-in header handled at the edge. We'll add an ingress adapter that looks for X-Compat-Trim: legacy and trims trailing zeros on responses for that request path. Low blast.

sdk-anna: I'll cut a 4.0.1 that defaults to trimmed vectors but keeps the alignment code behind a flag. Also publish release notes explicitly calling out padding behavior and the compat header. Patch can be ready in ~3h.

marco: Rollback runbook (short): 1) deploybot pin sdk us-central 3.9 2) disable any auto-unpin triggers 3) revert SDK deploy if partial 4) open support incident for affected ETL customers. Owner: marco.

ops-bot: Note: sample pin command: `/deploybot pin sdk us-central 3.9 --reason "rollback-padding"`

qa-bot: Suggest adding an automated regression that detects payload size changes for embeddings between SDK versions and flags >0.5% diff.

tess: Also, add a checklist item in release playbook: call out the padding alignment change and run the ETL consumer query to find partners with strict length checks.

sre-lee: I'll create a dashboard card for embedding_length_distribution and an alert if new lengths appear with >0.2% frequency. Will also whitelist the canary to not page on minor blips.

marco: Decision: 1) keep sdk pinned to 3.9 in us-central for now; 2) ops-bot hold auto-unpin 12h; 3) sdk-anna to prepare 4.0.1 patch defaulting to trimmed vectors; 4) ingress adapter to accept X-Compat-Trim header for legacy customers; 5) QA run preflight and then staged canary (staging -> 10% -> full) once patch is ready.

sdk-anna: PR opened: github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/2201 (chore/4.0.1-trim-default). Putting release notes draft in the PR. Requesting quick SME review from @tess.

marco: ETA for canary start: target today +6h after patch build. If canary is clean, schedule unpin automatic. If any consumers show errors, we re-pin immediately.

ops-bot: Hold remains until 7991115823 UTC or until manual release action.

qa-bot: I'll post the preflight matrix results to this thread when done. Also running the partner query to populate a list for support outreach.

tess: Thanks everyone. Please update status here during canary. Also remind release notes team to include the compat header example and migration steps.

marco: Follow-up: filing a small follow-up to add embedding-length-sanity check in CI (runtime + SDK matrix). Will link the ticket in the SDK PR. Closing loop once canary finishes. :white_check_mark:
